journey.title: Move a page brief through design and adoption
journey.purpose: A designer selects a scenario and page, reviews the live composition and evidence, then reaches the adoption handoff without losing the page context or the current candidate.

steps.intent: Choose the scenario whose page is being redesigned.
Choose a declared page and keep its design context visible.
Review the brief, live composition, candidate evidence, and responsive preview before refining the page.

claims.statement: The design flow keeps the selected scenario and page context attached while the designer moves from brief to candidate review and adoption handoff.
claims.rationale: The runtime journey executor is not yet a deterministic acceptance gate; this claim records the intended cross-page behavior without pretending it is proven.
